name: Vigilant Asset Allocation (Binary Breadth)
description: Keller & Keuning (2017) VAA. Monthly. Binary regime detection on offensive assets. Monitors offensive universe (equities/gold/commodity) breadth. If weak_count >= breadth_threshold: hold 100% single best defensive asset. Else: hold top_n offensive assets, equal-weighted. Uses 13612W momentum weighting (1m,3m,6m,12m with 12,4,2,1 weights).
